name: Declan O'Malley
bio:
Declan O'Malley brings a wealth of experience to his role as Security Chief at Tickford Racing. A former Garda Síochána officer, Declan transitioned into motorsport security after a chance encounter with a team owner needing reliable protection for valuable equipment and personnel. His meticulous approach and strategic thinking quickly made him indispensable.

Declan's focus extends beyond simple threat mitigation; he believes in proactively identifying potential vulnerabilities and implementing innovative security protocols. He prides himself on fostering a culture of vigilance and preparedness within the team. His ability to see the bigger picture, coupled with his relentless pursuit of perfection, ensures that Tickford Racing operates under the safest and most secure conditions possible, both on and off the track. Declan is driven to ensure the safety of his team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A stout man with a serious demeanor and a commanding presence.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn copy of Sun Tzu's 'The Art of War'.
Insists on personally inspecting every security checkpoint, no matter how minor.
Has a habit of sketching diagrams of security layouts on napkins during meetings.
